title: Hermes learning loop
subtitle: hermes learns outside WorkPilot (Telegram, cron, terminal). You decide what enters this project.

auto.tooltip: The loop runs on its own at the end of every build and when this panel opens (at most once every fifteen minutes). This button forces a pass now.

pipeline.learnHint: Skills hermes wrote from its own experience, seen on the last pass.
pipeline.triageHint: Out of this repository's scope or already provided: turned away without you, by rules the repository already wrote down.
pipeline.decideHint: What is waiting for your decision: keep or turn down.

review.keepTooltipBrain: Adopt into skills/hermes-learned/ and file it in the shared brain, linked to this task.

review.adoptedToBrain_other: {{count}} skills kept and filed in the shared brain.

details.declined_other: {{count}} turned-down skills will never be proposed again.

brain.title: Link with the shared brain
brain.description: Every kept skill — by you or by the loop — becomes a knowledge/hermes/ note in the brain: Claude Code, Codex, Gemini… can recall it. It is knowledge, not a rule: no agent applies it by default.
brain.off: No shared brain: kept skills stay in the repository only.
brain.readsBack: hermes reads the brain back (workpilot-brain MCP server connected).
brain.notReadingBack: hermes does not read the brain back yet: connect it from Settings.

soul.title: Persona (SOUL.md)
soul.description: Hermes reads SOUL.md from its own home and injects it as the identity of every session. This repository offers one; installing it is a copy you can undo — the persona it replaces is kept with a timestamp.

triage.title: Decided without you
triage.description: Hermes ships a catalogue of hundreds. What this repository already decided about it — the categories the hermes pack tracks, the names it excluded, the skills the packs provide — is applied here, so those candidates are never filed and the ones an older rule filed are withdrawn.

reason.out-of-scope: hermes category this repository does not track

adopted.title: Kept skills
adopted.description: Written to skills/{{pack}}/, a pack not listed in .workpilot/skills.toml: no agent loads them yet. Listing that pack is the decision that activates them — and the moment to rewrite hermes-only tool names. Deleting a folder turns it down.
